purpose: Prospectively fixed V4 candidate after exposed development screening and dependency-aware repair; references withheld from generation.
limitations: Independent assessment uses a separate prompt and withheld reference, but shares a model with the production reviewer. Model agreement is not proof of correctness.
The frozen corpus covers new passages from five known public-domain books; it does not cover all genres, languages, or corruption types.
One development screen is weak model-selection evidence; this prospective cohort must retain every failure and cannot prove universal reconstruction.
